The Orchid House

The orchid house is kept at 24 degrees Celsius with humidity held at 70 percent all year. The head keeper of the orchid house is Priya Raman.

Species on display

  • Phalaenopsis amabilis
  • Vanda coerulea
  • Dendrobium nobile

How to visit the orchid house

  1. Collect a timed ticket at the garden gate
  2. Show the ticket at the orchid house door
  3. Stay on the marked path between the benches
